analysis_method: Read saved receipts and current source; independently reproduced existing stable_mock_embedding with stdlib SHA256/random. No model evaluation, parser invocation for samples, native training, checkpoint mutation, or new-canary inspection.

findings.evidence: For finite nonzero targets and nonzero direction d=candidate-base, dot(target-base,d)>0 passes the self-loss checks and returns target itself; nonpositive dot yields step0 and returns base. All five failed training vectors exactly equal fallback; three passing training vectors and tuning30 exactly equal target.
findings.limit: Saved vectors do not expose raw candidate direction/margin; zero direction also returns fallback. No claim that failures are unlearnable.
findings.math: For even-dimensional fallback b=.02x+.1Jx, J is orthogonal/skew: cosine=.02/sqrt(.02^2+.1^2)=.196116135138184; MSE=(.98^2+.1^2)*mean(x^2)=.9704*mean(x^2).

findings.evidence: target_samples=validation_list or sample_list; training_report before/after refer to row30, already cosine1/MSE0. Strict acceptance needs finite positive tuning objective gain and no regressions. All15 accepted epochs selected legal_ir_view_logits. Embedding-only and family-only proposals had finite updates but zero tuning gain; combined candidates lost to larger IR-only objective gains.

All model family-logit scales zero and sample memory false; base logits zero without feature codec, hence nine-way uniform family CE and CE excess ln9=2.197224577336. _nudge_family_logits nevertheless writes feature, semantic-slot and legal-IR-view family maps; scales only zero their forward contributions. Baseline classifier activation must be a separate model-config experiment.
findings.finding: Family classifier inactive, expensive proposals remain
findings.limit: Do not generalize skip solely from scales across arbitrary codecs: learned-key ranking can depend on existence of state feature logits. Current fixture has no feature codec.

findings.evidence: _nudge_decoded_embedding uses target minus projected current plus cosine-direction term, distributes over active heads and samples sequentially. These are not derivatives through the target-return branch. Update-norm/rate reports are delta-derived, not mathematical gradient evidence.
findings.finding: Embedding updates are heuristic parameter nudges through discontinuous evaluation

findings.evidence: Optional refinement applies selected strict IR patch, then embedding nudges at .175,.0875,.04375. Requires finite strictly lower aggregate training MSE; screens this before bridge validation; requires unchanged full validation guards and at least the original winner positive objective delta. Then training gain breaks equal-validation ties. Refinement0 used in prior three-arm experiment.
findings.limit: Training screen is aggregate, so inspect per-row qualification as well. Prior separate single-span refine3 run passed7/8; duration22 stayed exact fallback at all three rates. That is evidence of capability, not a matched multi-sample guarantee.

findings.evidence: Mock embedding is eight pseudo-random coordinates seeded by the full-text SHA256. Nearby duration templates do not create a smooth semantic target; changing20 to21 changes an unrelated random embedding. Both old canary31/32 embeddings stayed fallback. These are optimizer fixtures, not federal-law heldout evidence. New34/35 are untouched within this experiment only; seed pretraining exclusion unknown.
